title: Salesforce CEO says he gave ‘App Store’ domain and trademark to Steve Jobs as a thank you
summary: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff revealed that he gifted the "App Store" domain and trademark to Steve Jobs and Apple as a thank you for advice Jobs gave him in 2003. This act of generosity occurred when Apple launched its own App Store for the iPhone, despite Benioff having already trademarked the term and owned the domain for his company's "App Exchange." The story highlights a unique moment of collaboration and respect between two tech giants from the Jobs era.
